name: Alvah
source:
[i]"I am your knight in shining armor! No one else may fill my shoes!"[/i]
[i]Wild and naughty mood maker.[/i]

Master Alvah is the most cheerful a and lively of the princes, warming his surroundings like a sun. His mental age leaves some things to be desired, but he makes friends easily and is a popular man.

Even when he is depressed out troubled, it never shows in his actions. His heart is seemingly indestructible. I hope he knows how to vent his frustrations too...
